name: jv_free
text:
#define LIBM_DD(name) \
static jv f_ ## name(jq_state *jq, jv input) { \
  if (jv_get_kind(input) != JV_KIND_NUMBER) { \
    return type_error(input, "number required"); \
  } \
  jv ret = jv_number(name(jv_number_value(input))); \
  jv_free(input); \
  return ret; \
}
